title: user_authentication_with_jwt_oauth_and_2fa
description: Verify that the user authentication system supports login and registration using JWT, OAuth providers (Google, GitHub, VK), and Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) flows correctly and securely.

title: end_to_end_encrypted_real_time_chat
description: Test the real-time chat system to ensure messages between students and teachers are encrypted end-to-end using RSA-OAEP, with no data leaks and reliable message delivery.

title: student_dashboard_course_and_profile_management
description: Validate that the student dashboard displays enrolled courses, challenges, solutions, ratings, chat access, and allows profile management functionalities correctly.

title: interactive_learning_platform_functionality
description: Ensure that the interactive learning platform supports lessons, quizzes, practice exercises, progress tracking, and discussion features as expected.

title: teacher_panel_course_and_submission_management
description: Verify that teachers can manage courses, view and grade student submissions, and communicate in real-time via chat within the teacher panel.

title: admin_panel_user_and_course_management
description: Test the administrative panel to confirm that admins can manage users, courses, and system settings effectively and securely.

title: multi_language_code_execution_and_linting
description: Validate that the code execution service correctly runs and lints code submissions in all supported programming languages, providing accurate output and feedback.

title: user_profile_and_settings_management
description: Ensure users can update their profiles, upload avatars, configure 2FA, set theme preferences, and manage notification settings persistently.

title: gamification_features_tracking_and_rewards
description: Verify that gamification elements such as daily streaks, achievements, gems, and streak freezes are tracked accurately and rewards are granted appropriately.

title: file_upload_for_chat_and_course_materials
description: Test the file upload functionality to ensure chat attachments and course materials can be uploaded without data loss or corruption.
